timing_semantics.search_scenario_generation_time: Independent search-pool generation only; already included in deployment_time.
timing_semantics.search_scoring_time: Completed-placement rank scoring only; a subset of search_time and deployment_time.
timing_semantics.search_time: Search logic excluding feature calculation and scenario generation; already included in deployment_time.
timing_semantics.deployment_time: Wall time from search-context construction through sensor selection; includes scenario generation, model loading, features, search, and search scoring.
timing_semantics.evaluation_time: Final localization evaluation after deployment; excluded from deployment_time.
